title: Old Fashioned Umami Chinese Leaf Hash
description: A shaggy, nostalgic Chinese dish from Jiangsu, featuring Chinese leaf and a rich umami flavor, cooked in a large paella pan. This egg-free friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large paella pan over medium high heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the Chinese leaf and cook for 2 minutes, until it starts to wilt.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and sesame oil.
Pour the sauce into the paella pan and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, until it has thickened slightly.
Stir in the chopped scallions and cook for 1 minute, until they are wilted.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
